sar.narrative: On 2016-11-17, customer account C03042 on card C03042-K1 incurred unauthorized activity totaling $599.94. Transaction 3464869 was executed via online channel under product category 'R' in billing region 327.0. Graph traversal identified that the activity originated from an unverified source inconsistent with the cardholder's historical baseline. When contacted for validation, the customer explicitly denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed physical retention of the card. The pattern represents unauthorized card-not-present exploitation. The compromised card was blocked, reissue initiated, and funds protected under Policy Rule R2.
